src/configuration.c

This module supplies data-driven property registries and validates configuration values. Scoring algorithms do not know these property names.

Construct the base, adversarial and calibration schemas

Section titled “Construct the base, adversarial and calibration schemas”

The base table preserves the original ten properties and types. Extra names deliberately differ in operational words such as seconds, milliseconds, internal and external. Calibration uses a separate vocabulary. registries_init caches all names once. The collision and length-boundary schemas are deliberate tests, not production defaults.

Generate larger registries only for timing

Section titled “Generate larger registries only for timing”

registry_scale keeps the base names and adds deterministic indexed identifiers. Some share prefixes; others use telemetry names. These registries measure work at 10, 50, 100 and 1000 properties. Their timing does not establish accuracy for a real 1000-property schema.

127/** Keep the original ten names; add deterministic unrelated and similar names for timing only. */128int registry_scale(Registry *registry, Property *property, size_t count) {129    size_t index;130    char name[KEY_MAX + 1];131    Registry *base_registry = registry_get("base");132    if (count < 10 || count > MAX_PROPERTIES) return 0;133    for (index = 0; index < 10; ++index) property[index] = base_registry->p[index];134    for (index = 10; index < count; ++index) {135        if (index % 3 == 0) (void) snprintf(name, sizeof name, "DefaultRequestTimeoutSecondsChannel%04zu", index);136        else if (index % 3 == 1) (void) snprintf(name, sizeof name, "TelemetryComponent%04zuBufferCapacity", index);137        else (void) snprintf(name, sizeof name, "BackgroundTaskExecutionIntervalWorker%04zu", index);138        if (!property_init(&property[index], name, TYPE_STRING, 0)) return 0;139    }140    return registry_init(registry, "scaling", property, count);141}

Validate complete values with standard numeric conversion

Section titled “Validate complete values with standard numeric conversion”

Strings must be nonempty and booleans must be exactly true or false. Integer text permits one leading sign and otherwise only digits. strtol then detects overflow through errno, checks the end pointer, and enforces the target int range. The digit scan is necessary because strtol alone accepts leading whitespace.

142/** [PM-Va2lG6] Values stay strings until name resolution succeeds.143 * Accept a complete decimal integer, not a partial parse like "10seconds".144 * Boolean spellings are exactly true/false; string properties require nonempty text. */145int value_valid(const Property *property, const char *text) {146    char *end;147    long value;148    size_t index = 0;149    if (property->type == TYPE_STRING) return *text != '\0';150    if (property->type == TYPE_BOOLEAN) return !strcmp(text, "true") || !strcmp(text, "false");151    if (text[index] == '+' || text[index] == '-') ++index;152    if (!text[index]) return 0;153    for (; text[index]; ++index) if (!isdigit((unsigned char)text[index])) return 0;154    errno = 0;155    /* strtol reports two different problems: errno catches overflow;156     * end points to the first unconsumed byte. Both must indicate success. */157    value = strtol(text, &end, 10);158    return !errno && !* end && value >= INT_MIN && value <= INT_MAX;159}

Reject unresolved keys, invalid types, duplicates and omissions

Section titled “Reject unresolved keys, invalid types, duplicates and omissions”

bind_lines marks canonical property indices, not raw spellings. Consequently port and p-o-r-t are duplicates after resolution. The final pass checks required properties. The first error returns a diagnostic and no application state is changed.

160/** Validate only: parse -> resolve -> type-check -> mark canonical index seen.161 * "port" and "p-o-r-t" hit the same seen slot, so spelling variants cannot overwrite. */162int bind_lines(const Registry *registry, const char *const * lines, size_t count, size_t algorithm, Policy policy, char *diagnostic,163    size_t diagnostic_capacity) {164    unsigned char already_bound[MAX_PROPERTIES] = {0};165    size_t index;166    Entry entry;167    for (index = 0; index < count; ++index) {168        Resolution result;169        if (parse_entry(lines[index], &entry) != PARSE_OK) {170            (void) snprintf(diagnostic, diagnostic_capacity, "parse error at line %zu", index + 1);171            return 0;172        }173        result = resolve(registry, entry.key, algorithm, policy);174        if (!match_is_accepted(result.status)) {175            (void) snprintf(diagnostic, diagnostic_capacity, "unresolved key at line %zu: %s", index + 1, entry.key);176            return 0;177        }178        if (!value_valid(&registry->p[result.first], entry.value)) {179            (void) snprintf(diagnostic, diagnostic_capacity, "invalid value for %s", registry->p[result.first].name);180            return 0;181        }182        if (already_bound[result.first]) {183            (void) snprintf(diagnostic, diagnostic_capacity, "duplicate property %s", registry->p[result.first].name);184            return 0;185        }186        already_bound[result.first] = 1;187    }188    for (index = 0; index < registry->n; ++index) if (registry->p[index].required && !already_bound[index]) {189        (void) snprintf(diagnostic, diagnostic_capacity, "missing required property %s", registry->p[index].name);190        return 0;191    }192    if (diagnostic_capacity) diagnostic[0] = '\0';193    return 1;194}195

Apply values only after the entire batch validates

Section titled “Apply values only after the entire batch validates”

The second pass repeats deterministic resolution and writes strings plus typed values into Configuration. Parsing already bounded each value, so its copy includes the terminator safely. For a batch containing port=123 and an invalid boolean, validation fails before the destination is cleared. Inputs and registry must stay immutable between the two passes.

Reference for the contracts used in this file

Section titled “Reference for the contracts used in this file”

C99 section 7.20.1.4 defines strtol, its end pointer and range-error behavior. These checks belong to value validation after name resolution. Open reference.

196/** [PM-Bi7nA3] Two passes protect the destination: validate everything, then apply.197 * Any failure in pass one leaves the old Configuration untouched.198 * Pass two repeats deterministic lookups; inputs/registry must stay immutable. */199int bind_configuration(const Registry *registry, const char *const * lines, size_t count, size_t algorithm, Policy policy, Configuration *out,200    char *diagnostic, size_t diagnostic_capacity) {201    size_t index;202    if (!out || !registry || registry->n > MAX_PROPERTIES) {203        (void) snprintf(diagnostic, diagnostic_capacity, "invalid binding destination");204        return 0;205    }206    if (!bind_lines(registry, lines, count, algorithm, policy, diagnostic, diagnostic_capacity)) return 0;207    /* Only validated batches reach this commit point. */208    memset(out, 0, sizeof *out);209    out->n = registry->n;210    for (index = 0; index < count; ++index) {211        Entry entry;212        Resolution resolved;213        BoundValue *value;214        (void) parse_entry(lines[index], &entry);215        resolved = resolve(registry, entry.key, algorithm, policy);216        /* The index selects canonical storage. Different input spellings217         * therefore cannot create two separate values for the same property. */218        value = &out->values[resolved.first];219        value->present = 1;220        /* Parser bounded this string to VALUE_MAX; destination has the same capacity. */221        memcpy(value->raw, entry.value, strlen(entry.value) + 1);222        if (registry->p[resolved.first].type == TYPE_INTEGER) value->integer = (int) strtol(entry.value, NULL, 10);223        if (registry->p[resolved.first].type == TYPE_BOOLEAN) value->boolean = !strcmp(entry.value, "true");224    }225    return 1;226}
